deliverables: Instant on-chain distribution to the intended recipient upon enactment
request.recipient: Ikigai Info governance action submitter / intended recipient; specific address not stated in document
request.what: Reimburse the lost deposit for an Info governance action titled Cardanoの生きがい - Ikigai - and compensate estimated missed staking rewards.

claims.claim: The Ikigai Info governance action was submitted in September 2024 shortly after the Chang hard fork introduced on-chain governance.
The Ikigai action was symbolic and asked the community whether they agreed with a statement of thanks and hope for Cardano's future.
A Cardano node bug allowed an unregistered stake key to be used in the governance action, preventing recovery of the 100,000 ADA deposit.
The proposal references an AdaStat governance page for the original Ikigai governance action.
The requested withdrawal is 103,000 ADA, consisting of the original 100,000 ADA deposit plus 3,000 ADA for missed staking rewards at 2% per annum.
The proposer states there are no costs or expenses associated with this treasury withdrawal beyond the reimbursement amount.
The proposer states there are no circumstances under which the withdrawal might be refunded to the Cardano Treasury.
The proposer states the recipient has not previously received treasury funds.
The proposer states the requested amount does not exceed the current Net Change Limit.
The proposer states that because funds go directly to the intended recipient and can be audited on-chain, no audit or oversight budget and no administrator custody controls are required.

summary: The document requests 103,000 ADA to reimburse an allegedly unrecoverable 100,000 ADA governance-action deposit plus estimated missed staking rewards, but most material assertions are proposer-stated and the document provides only one external governance-action reference.
